body: I'm not able to reproduce, tested on 4.7.stable and 4.6.3. The print is as follows on both versions regardless of the subthreads toggle being on or off: On: Off: Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.31019.2002) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 127.9 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

If it's my MRP, then maybe something to do with my specs is causing it I suppose. If you've made your own reproduction(s), would you be willing to share those? Furthermore if you haven't yet had a chance would you be able to test if the expected result happens in my MRP when you run it? I'm afraid sadly this is where I get a bit out of my depth... I'll have a look into that PR and see if I can understand it a little more, though I gather that in 4.7 maybe a slight adjustment has been made to threaded loading - if I had to guess randomly perhaps some old less efficient implementation has been removed that was core to devices with my specs using sub_threads properly? But I digress, I'm just guessing from a skim. I'll look closer now. Interestingly I haven't seen any other resources fail to load (so far!) the way TileSets have.

The issues #118185 and especially #115985 are right on the money for what I'm experiencing. It's strange as clearly efforts have been put into fixing those related problems specifically in 4.7 (#118824 as you mentioned @jauwnio). I'm not sure why it's suddenly reared its head, and only on my device by the sounds of it.

I'm really sorry, this is my first ever github bug report. How can I ensure the appropriate people (if any!) who would want to be aware of this development in those issues, are made aware? I don't want to pester anyone or cause issues.
